description.content: Returns a paginated list of optimization recipes visible to the authenticated tenant. Recipes encapsulate optimizer configuration and can be filtered by name, description, status, system flag, and the user who created or last modified them.

query.description: Match part of the recipe name
Match part of the recipe description
Filter on the Vendor UserId of the Vendor User that created this Recipe. Accepts `null` to explicitly filter by empty value
Filter on the Vendor UserId Of the Vendor User that last modified this Recipe. Accepts `null` to explicitly filter by empty value
Sort in format column,direction. Valid columns: name, system, modifiedByVendorUserId, createdByVendorUserId. Valid directions: asc, desc. e.g. sort=name,desc

response.name: Invalid value for: query parameter name, Invalid value for: query parameter description, Invalid value for: query parameter status, Invalid value for: query parameter system, Invalid value for: query parameter createdByVendorUserId, Invalid value for: query parameter modifiedByVendorUserId, Invalid value for: query parameter sort

description.content: Creates a new optimization recipe for the authenticated tenant. The recipe encapsulates optimizer settings such as objective weights and feature options that can be referenced when starting optimization runs.
Returns the full configuration of a single recipe identified by its ID, including its name, description, status, and optimizer settings.
Replaces the configuration of an existing recipe identified by its ID. This will affect any future optimization runs that reference this recipe.

item.name: Set the default recipe for a tenant

request.name: Set the default recipe for a tenant

description.content: Designates the specified recipe as the default for the authenticated tenant. When no explicit recipe is provided at the time of scheduling, this recipe's settings will be used.

item.name: Get the default recipe of the tenant

request.name: Get the default recipe of the tenant

description.content: Returns the recipe currently set as the default for the authenticated tenant. Returns 204 No Content if no default recipe has been configured.
